mentions.name: Money Quest
mentions.description: This is a serious game that supports schools and parents in teaching children to become more financially literate, helping kids learn the right ways to spend and save money. The project is still early in development.
mentions.problem: Financial literacy is missing from many people's education and upbringing, leaving them less responsible when managing their finances.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://playmoneyquest.com 
A serious game that supports schools or parents to teach children in becoming (more) financial literate. I feel like I missed this completely in my own education / upbringing, and I feel this could help people become more responsible when it comes to managing their finances. Teach kids the right ways to spend or save money, and they're set for life.
